items.title: Tractor Supply (TSCO) Stock May Be 7% Above Fair Value
items.summary: Tractor Supply has had a rough stretch, with the share price sitting at US$37.40 after a year where the stock fell 30.9%. With the market already marking the retailer down, the core question now is whether that current price lines up with the cash flows the business is expected to generate. The roughly 30.9% decline over the past year puts Tractor Supply's valuation under the spotlight because such a move can signal that investors are rethinking how durable its cash generation really is.
